items.title: 77th Constitution Day (26 November)
items.text: India marked Constitution Day (Samvidhan Divas) on 26 November 2026. The Constituent Assembly adopted the Constitution on this day in 1949. The day was officially declared in 2015.
items.gk: The Constitution came into force on 26 January 1950 (Republic Day).

items.title: ₹11,000 crore scheme for building machines
items.text: The Union Cabinet approved a ₹11,000 crore scheme to make construction and infrastructure equipment (like tunnel boring machines) in India. The Ministry of Heavy Industries will run it for eight years from 2026-27.
items.gk: India now imports most tunnel boring machines, mainly from China and Europe.

items.title: New airport for Silchar, Assam
items.text: On 25 November, the Cabinet Committee on Economic Affairs approved a new (greenfield) airport at Doloo in Cachar district, Assam, costing ₹2,014 crore. The Airports Authority of India will build it.
items.gk: Silchar is the main city of Assam's Barak Valley.

items.title: Six urea plants to be expanded
items.text: Six existing (brownfield) urea plants will get new units worth about ₹54,000 crore. Each will make 12.7 lakh tonnes a year. Sites include Nangal (Punjab), Shahjahanpur (UP) and Panagarh (West Bengal).
items.gk: Urea is the most used nitrogen fertiliser in India.

items.title: US plans 25% tariff on Indian goods
items.text: The US proposed a 25% tariff on Indian goods under Section 301 of its trade law. Among 14 economies, only Vietnam (35%) got a higher rate. India says it has no excess capacity and wants a trade deal with the US.
items.gk: A tariff is a tax on goods coming from another country.

items.title: Retail inflation crosses 6%
items.text: Retail inflation rose to 6.09% in October 2026. This is above the RBI's upper limit of 6% for the first time under the new CPI series (base year 2024). Food inflation was 8.94%.
items.gk: The RBI's inflation target is 4%, with a band of 2% to 6%.

items.title: Forex reserves at US$ 737.78 billion
items.text: India's foreign exchange reserves rose to US$ 737.78 billion by the end of September 2026, from US$ 691.11 billion, says the RBI's half-yearly report.
items.gk: The RBI manages India's foreign exchange reserves.

items.title: Exercise Surya Kiran (India–Nepal)
items.text: The 20th India–Nepal army exercise Surya Kiran began on 25 November 2026 at Saljhandi, Nepal. It runs till 8 December. India sent soldiers from the Kumaon Regiment.
items.gk: Surya Kiran is the India–Nepal army exercise (also the name of the IAF aerobatic team).

items.title: INS Ashank joins the Navy
items.text: GRSE delivered INS Ashank to the Navy at Visakhapatnam on 23 November. It is the sixth of eight Arnala-class anti-submarine shallow water craft and GRSE's 120th warship.
items.gk: GRSE (Garden Reach Shipbuilders and Engineers) is in Kolkata.

items.title: JWALA MK-1 anti-drone missile tested
items.text: The JWALA MK-1 counter-drone micro-missile had its first flight test on 23 November at Pokhran, Rajasthan. It can hit drones up to 5 km away.
items.gk: Pokhran is also where India did its nuclear tests (1974 and 1998).

items.title: India to host 2028 Thomas and Uber Cup
items.text: The Badminton World Federation gave New Delhi the 2028 Thomas Cup (men) and Uber Cup (women). India last hosted them in 2014.
items.gk: Thomas Cup = men's team badminton; Uber Cup = women's team badminton.

items.title: India hosts IORA ministers' meeting
items.text: India hosts the 25th Council of Ministers meeting of the Indian Ocean Rim Association (IORA) in New Delhi on 27 November 2026.
items.gk: IORA's secretariat is in Mauritius.

items.title: 5th Kashi Tamil Sangamam
items.text: The 5th Kashi Tamil Sangamam will be held in Varanasi from 28 November to 12 December 2026. Its theme is learning the Thirukkural.
items.gk: The Thirukkural was written by the Tamil poet Thiruvalluvar.

items.title: India wins Visitors' Lion at Venice
items.text: India's pavilion won the Visitors' Lion for Best National Participation at the 61st Venice Art Biennale in Italy.
items.gk: The Venice Biennale is one of the world's oldest art exhibitions.

items.title: Kerala dairy farmer wins Gopal Ratna
items.text: Muralidharan Nair from Kerala is among the first-prize winners of the National Gopal Ratna Award 2026 for dairy. The first prize is ₹5 lakh.
items.gk: Gopal Ratna Awards are given under the Rashtriya Gokul Mission.

items.title: Two new geckos found in Meghalaya
items.text: Scientists described two new cave-dwelling bent-toed geckos from the Khasi Hills of Meghalaya.
items.gk: Meghalaya's capital is Shillong.

quiz.q: On which date is Constitution Day (Samvidhan Divas) observed in India?
quiz.e: The Constitution was adopted on 26 November 1949. So Constitution Day is 26 November.
w: 26 January is Republic Day, when the Constitution came into force.
15 August is Independence Day.
2 October is Gandhi Jayanti.

quiz.q: The Cabinet approved a ₹11,000 crore scheme to make which items in India?
quiz.e: The scheme is for construction and infrastructure equipment, like tunnel boring machines. The Ministry of Heavy Industries runs it.
w: Mobile phones have a different PLI scheme.
Electric buses were not part of this news.
Solar panels were not part of this news.

quiz.q: Where will the new greenfield airport for Silchar be built?
quiz.e: The airport will be at Doloo in Cachar district, Assam. It costs ₹2,014 crore.
w: Agartala is in Tripura.
Dibrugarh is in Assam but far from Silchar.
Imphal is in Manipur; Silchar is in Assam.

quiz.q: Retail inflation in October 2026 crossed the RBI's upper limit. What was it?
quiz.e: Retail inflation was 6.09%. The RBI's upper limit is 6%.
w: 8.94% was food inflation only.
5.3% was S&P's forecast for the whole year.
4% is the RBI's target, not the October figure.

quiz.q: Exercise Surya Kiran is a joint military exercise between India and which country?
quiz.e: Surya Kiran is the India–Nepal army exercise. The 20th edition is at Saljhandi, Nepal.
w: Mitra Shakti is the India–Sri Lanka exercise.
Sampriti is the India–Bangladesh exercise.
Bhutan was not part of this exercise.

quiz.q: Which city will host the 2028 Thomas and Uber Cup badminton finals?
quiz.e: The BWF gave New Delhi the 2028 Thomas and Uber Cup. India last hosted them in 2014.
w: Bengaluru was not named as the host.
Lucknow hosts other badminton events, not this one.
Hyderabad was not named as the host.

quiz.q: INS Ashank, delivered to the Navy, was built by which shipyard?
quiz.e: GRSE built INS Ashank. It is GRSE's 120th warship.
w: Cochin Shipyard built other Arnala-class ships, not INS Ashank.
Mazagon Dock builds submarines and destroyers; not this ship.
Goa Shipyard did not build this ship.

quiz.q: The 5th Kashi Tamil Sangamam (2026) has which theme?
quiz.e: The theme is learning the Thirukkural. It runs in Varanasi from 28 November to 12 December.
w: Silk was not the theme.
Millets were not the theme.
Yoga was not the theme.

items.title: Wayanad: Kerala's first e-waste-free district
items.text: Wayanad finished a three-month drive to collect and safely process e-waste. CM V. D. Satheesan will announce it at Kalpetta on 27 November. The next goal is carbon neutrality.
items.gk: Wayanad district headquarters: Kalpetta.

items.title: Kerala launches 'Avalkkoppam' (With Her)
items.text: Kerala's Women and Child Development Department started Avalkkoppam to fight domestic and cyber violence against women. Budget: ₹40 lakh.
items.gk: It is part of the UN 'Orange the World' campaign (till 10 December).

items.title: Day for Elimination of Violence against Women (25 Nov)
items.text: Observed on 25 November. It starts the '16 Days of Activism' (25 November to 10 December).
items.gk: The date remembers the Mirabal sisters, killed in the Dominican Republic in 1960.

items.title: SAMAVESH portal launched
items.text: The Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment launched SAMAVESH in New Delhi. It joins 20+ portals with one login and an AI chatbot in many languages.
items.gk: Minister of Social Justice and Empowerment: Dr Virendra Kumar.

items.title: Australia–Solomon Islands security treaty
items.text: Signed on 25 November 2026. Australia becomes the main security partner of the Solomon Islands. The treaty does not allow foreign military bases.
items.gk: Capital of Solomon Islands: Honiara.

items.title: Miss Universe 2026: Jennifer Barreto (Puerto Rico)
items.text: She won the 75th Miss Universe in San Juan, Puerto Rico. It is Puerto Rico's sixth title. Costa Rica will host in 2027.

items.title: Javed Akhtar gets Mahatma Phule Samata Puraskar 2026
items.text: The lyricist and poet will receive it in Pune on 28 November.
items.gk: Javed Akhtar won the Sahitya Akademi Award (Urdu, 2013) for 'Lava'.

items.title: Kalyan Krishnamurthy steps down as Flipkart CEO
items.text: He led Flipkart since January 2017. A new CEO will be named soon.
items.gk: Flipkart is owned by Walmart (USA).

items.title: Voyager 1 reaches one light-day from Earth
items.text: On 18 November 2026, NASA's Voyager 1 became about one light-day (25.9 billion km) away. Its Golden Record has an Indian raga by Kesarbai Kerkar.
items.gk: Voyager 1 was launched on 5 September 1977.

items.title: First industry-built PSLV by early 2027
items.text: ISRO plans to launch PSLV-N1, built by HAL and L&T, in the first quarter of 2027.
items.gk: ISRO Chairman: Dr V. Narayanan. ISRO headquarters: Bengaluru.

items.title: Exercise Harimau Shakti 2026
items.text: 6th India–Malaysia army exercise, held at Ipoh, Malaysia, from 18 to 30 November 2026.
items.gk: India–Nepal army exercise is called Suryakiran.

items.title: Vaibhav Sooryavanshi: fastest List A double century
items.text: He scored 204 off 52 balls for India A against UAE in Doha, hitting 27 sixes.

items.title: First BIMSTEC U-23 Athletics in Bhubaneswar
items.text: Started on 25 November 2026 at Kalinga Stadium, Odisha, with athletes from six countries.
items.gk: BIMSTEC has 7 members; its secretariat is in Dhaka.

items.title: Shiv Nadar tops Hurun Philanthropy List again
items.text: Shiv Nadar and family gave ₹2,593 crore in 2025-26, topping the list for the fifth year. The Adani family was second.

items.title: Lonar Lake in world geological heritage list
items.text: Lonar crater lake in Buldhana, Maharashtra, was added to the IUGS list of 100 more geological heritage sites.
items.gk: Lonar Lake was made by a meteorite impact.

quiz.q: Which became Kerala's first e-waste-free district?
quiz.e: Wayanad finished a three-month drive to collect and safely process e-waste.

quiz.q: Kerala's 'Avalkkoppam' initiative fights:
o: Domestic and cyber violence against women
quiz.e: Avalkkoppam ('With Her') by Kerala's Women and Child Development Department targets domestic and cyber violence.

quiz.q: Who won Miss Universe 2026 (75th edition)?
quiz.e: Jennifer Barreto of Puerto Rico won in San Juan.

quiz.e: Harimau Shakti is the India–Malaysia army exercise; the 2026 edition was at Ipoh.

quiz.q: The International Day for the Elimination of Violence against Women is on:
quiz.e: 25 November; it starts 16 Days of Activism till 10 December.

quiz.q: Lonar Lake, added to a world geological heritage list, is in:
quiz.e: Lonar crater lake is in Buldhana district, Maharashtra.

items.title: Guru Nanak Jayanti (24 November)
items.text: Guru Nanak Jayanti fell on 24 November this year, the same day as Kartik Purnima. Guru Nanak Dev was born in 1469 at Rai Bhoi di Talwandi, now Nankana Sahib in Pakistan.
items.gk: Guru Nanak founded Sikhism and was the first of the ten Sikh Gurus.

items.title: Lachit Divas in Assam (24 November)
items.text: Assam marks Lachit Divas to honour Lachit Borphukan, the Ahom army commander born in 1622.
items.gk: Lachit Borphukan defeated the Mughals in the Battle of Saraighat in 1671.

items.title: Guru Tegh Bahadur martyrdom day
items.text: The 351st martyrdom anniversary of Guru Tegh Bahadur was observed on 24 November. He was executed in Delhi in 1675.
items.gk: Guru Tegh Bahadur was the ninth Sikh Guru and is called 'Hind di Chadar' (Shield of India).

items.title: National Milk Day on 26 November in Patna
items.text: The Department of Animal Husbandry and Dairying will hold National Milk Day 2026 in Patna, Bihar. The National Gopal Ratna Awards 2026 will be given there.
items.gk: National Milk Day marks the birth anniversary of Dr Verghese Kurien, the Father of the White Revolution.

items.title: West Bengal Cabinet approves new name 'Paschim Banga'
items.text: On 23 November 2026 the West Bengal Cabinet approved renaming the state as Paschim Banga. The name is not changed yet: Parliament must approve it.
items.gk: Parliament can change the name of a state under Article 3 of the Constitution.

items.title: Kerala: Edamalakkudy tribal panchayat
items.text: Edamalakkudy in Idukki district is Kerala's first tribal grama panchayat. It serves 26 tribal settlements and about 2,300 people.
items.gk: The main community there is the Muthuvan tribe.

items.title: India–Nepal ₹15,000 crore development package
items.text: Nepal's Prime Minister Balendra Shah visited India on 22–23 November 2026. India announced a ₹15,000 crore package for railways, pipelines, bridges and the 669 MW Lower Arun hydro project.
items.gk: Capital of Nepal: Kathmandu. Currency: Nepalese rupee.

items.title: RBI keeps SBI, HDFC Bank and ICICI Bank as D-SIBs
items.text: The RBI kept SBI, HDFC Bank and ICICI Bank on its 2026 list of Domestic Systemically Important Banks (D-SIBs), banks considered 'too big to fail'.
items.gk: RBI Governor: Sanjay Malhotra. RBI was set up in 1935; headquarters in Mumbai.

items.title: JWALA MK-1 counter-drone missile tested
items.text: JWALA MK-1, an Indian counter-drone micro-missile system, was test-fired at Pokhran, Rajasthan, on 23 November 2026. Its range is up to 5 km.
items.gk: Pokhran is also where India held its nuclear tests in 1974 and 1998.

items.title: GRSE delivers 'Ashank' to the Navy
items.text: Garden Reach Shipbuilders and Engineers (GRSE) delivered Ashank, an Arnala-class anti-submarine shallow-water craft, to the Indian Navy at Visakhapatnam. It has over 80% Indian-made content.
items.gk: GRSE is based in Kolkata.

items.title: BepiColombo enters Mercury's orbit
items.text: BepiColombo, a joint mission of the European (ESA) and Japanese (JAXA) space agencies, entered orbit around Mercury on 21 November 2026. It was launched in October 2018.
items.gk: Mercury is the smallest planet and the closest to the Sun.

items.title: India's first Human Metabolic Chamber
items.text: India's first Human Metabolic Chamber was opened at CMC Vellore, Tamil Nadu, set up with TIFR. It measures how much energy the human body uses.
items.gk: TIFR = Tata Institute of Fundamental Research, Mumbai.

items.title: FIFA Women's World Cup hosts chosen
items.text: FIFA chose the USA, Mexico, Costa Rica and Jamaica to host the 2031 Women's World Cup, with 48 teams. The United Kingdom will host the 2035 edition.
items.gk: FIFA headquarters: Zurich, Switzerland.

quiz.q: National Milk Day is celebrated on the birth anniversary of whom?
quiz.e: National Milk Day (26 November) marks the birth anniversary of Dr Verghese Kurien, Father of the White Revolution.

quiz.q: Lachit Borphukan defeated the Mughals in which battle?
quiz.e: Ahom commander Lachit Borphukan won the Battle of Saraighat in 1671.

quiz.q: Under which Article can Parliament change the name of a state?
quiz.e: Article 3 lets Parliament form new states and change the names or borders of states. West Bengal's 'Paschim Banga' proposal needs this approval.

quiz.q: The BepiColombo mission entered the orbit of which planet in November 2026?
quiz.e: BepiColombo, by ESA and JAXA, entered Mercury's orbit on 21 November 2026.

quiz.q: Where was the JWALA MK-1 counter-drone missile system test-fired?
quiz.e: It was test-fired at Pokhran, Rajasthan, on 23 November 2026.

quiz.q: Which country will host the FIFA Women's World Cup 2035?
quiz.e: FIFA chose the United Kingdom (England, Scotland, Wales, Northern Ireland) for 2035.
